name: Ric Piccolo (Bordello A Parigi/Toy Tonics)
description:
Ric Piccolo is an Argentinian producer and DJ who explores various genres such as disco, Italo disco, house, and rare grooves with left-field vibes.
As a DJ, his style ranges from obscure disco madness to the most innovative contemporary sounds for the dancefloor. His freestyle
sets captivate dedicated obscure music fans worldwide. 
As a producer, he has released multiple EPs on labels such as Toy Tonics, Bordello A Parigi, Slow Motion, Soundway, BBE, and Boots & Legs. He is also one half of Furotica (formerly known as Furor Exótica) alongside vocalist Barbie Garbage. Their style blends Italo-disco, electro, and house. He is a digger and reworker of rare records from Argentina, bringing these hidden treasures to light through mixetapes, releases, and compilations like Pampas-Disco-Shock, Australworks, The Sound of Pampas, Síntesis Moderna, and Danza Secreta.
Since 2013, his music has taken him on extensive tours across South America, Europe, and Asia, performing at numerous clubs and festivals worldwide.
—
Gratis inngang
